content_html:
Biology only seems to do n=1 production

Darwinism is an idea consistent with, and contributing to, the Divergent World Machine. It is also a framework through which to view the proliferating canonicities that define the Divergent Machine.

Divergence relies on canons to behave like species, i.e. they are one thing, and to be something else they must birth something new, slightly modified.

Meanwhile Liveness containerizes darwinism: you can try on multiple versions of multiple things, then use the ones that survive—the ones you like—to do things in your own unique way.

Case in point, I am writing this from a fully custom app while @lightsong wrote his from within obsidian.
